scope: One smaller-update trial to retain the existing numeric task after the complete condition matrix repaired the confirmed gate and missing-field failures.
reason: The matrix trial passed all four condition checks but lost four of 176 existing numeric development answers, exceeding the registered two-percentage-point retention margin. Other task families remained inside that margin.
unchanged: Training records, development, calibration, sealed test, parent checkpoint, seed and all acceptance checks are unchanged. Only the learning rate is halved.
selection: Freeze only if all registered repair and retention checks pass. Otherwise preserve the failed result and reassess the remaining defect before any further trial. Jev percentages are descriptive comparisons.
